// Passive copies of native diagnostics before FlushErrors empties the buffer.
// This observer exists only in the temporary reference overlay.
package base
var syncgoEscapeFlushed []string
func syncgoCaptureEscapeWarnings(){syncgoEscapeFlushed=append(syncgoEscapeFlushed,SyncgoLoopWarnings()...)}
func SyncgoEscapeWarnings()[]string{out:=append([]string(nil),syncgoEscapeFlushed...);return append(out,SyncgoLoopWarnings()...)}
